hooks.command: bash -c 'p=$(jq -r .tool_input.file_path 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [[ "$p" == */practices/rules/*.md ]] || [[ "$p" == */specs/spring-practices-l0.yaml ]] || [[ "$p" == *backend/src/*/practices/* ]]; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && bash practices/evals/spec_ref_guard.sh && bash practices/evals/substance_guard.sh && bash practices/evals/evidence_guard.sh; fi'
hooks.description: Pre-edit: run practices/ hard gates when the edit target is a rule.md, the seed spec, or backend practices fixture
